"Triple Red 7s Tripler" is about halfway through its run, with about half of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

If you play "Triple Red 7s Tripler" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
